role: Personal-infra 'fully aware' layer: surface generator, next-session parser, boot-pack assembler.

do_not_read.entry: state/ -- local-only, gitignored session scratch (boot pack, surfaces cache, logs); regenerate, never read/commit.

pitfalls.entry: Tools here are D30-class read-only: they never fetch, mutate, commit, push, or merge in any repo -- keep them that way.
Coupling by data contract only: shareable repos never import from this repo; surface/v1 and next-session/v2 are the only interface.
Never merge or direct-push to a default branch -- merge is Anthony's.
